beats.care: Coming from Mumbai by private bus? You may be dropped near Navale Bridge, so plan your last stretch to Katraj.
beats.what: From October 17, on trial, heavy vehicles heading to Katraj are stopped at points like Navale Bridge, Shindewadi Bridge and Mantarwadi Chowk.
beats.why: Construction has started on the Katraj station of the underground Swargate–Katraj metro line at Katraj Chowk.

cards.body: Parking is banned on both sides of the Wonder City–Katraj bypass, Morebaug and the old tunnel routes.
cards.title: Where to park? Not here

opts: To make room for metro station construction
cards.q: Why are heavy vehicles kept out of Katraj Chowk?
cards.why: Traffic police want to clear space at Katraj Chowk while the underground metro station is built.

cards.q: Worth the traffic pain for a Katraj metro?

cards.body: Shindewadi Bridge, Navale Bridge, Mantarwadi Chowk and Khadi Machine Chowk, depending on where they come from.
cards.caption: places where heavy vehicles are stopped

hook: Why are trucks and buses being *stopped before Katraj* now?

learn.t: Katraj station is part of the underground Swargate–Katraj metro extension.

sources.name: Pune Pulse
sources.title: Pune Traffic Diversions, Heavy Vehicle Ban Begin At Katraj For Metro Station Work

tldr: Pune Traffic Police have banned heavy vehicles near Katraj Chowk from October 17 so work can begin on the underground Katraj metro station.
